mechanical_gates.golden_harness: 48/48 demos green, T1+T2+replay byte-identical, no re-bless (r2/gates-harness.log)

findings.title: Pullback fit-floor never re-pins the camera center — a floor-clamped pullback can converge with the new district still off-screen
findings.detail: Real map 40x30 tiles (1040x780 px), height-bound fit: at zoom 1.0 the visible height is exactly the world height, so only cy=390 shows the whole map. A camera panned to the bottom clamp at high zoom (cy up to 585) that floor-clamps to 1.0 keeps its off-center center — camera_update never clamps and pullback_feed never calls camera_clamp_center — so world y in [0,195) stays cut off after the ~2s ease. Violates the ruled contract ('at the fit-view floor if beyond' implies the district becomes visible) and the PR body's own claim.
findings.fix: In pullback_feed, pass (cx_to, cy_to) through rnd.camera_clamp_center(..., z_to, world) before assigning cam_wx_to/cam_wy_to; add a floor test with an off-center camera asserting district inclusion at convergence.

findings.title: NOC wheel-ownership + modal-block policy (effect_zoom/effect_pan) has zero automated coverage — hard-bar (c) rests on manual captures only
findings.detail: Acceptance item 'NOC wheel-ownership respected' is implemented correctly (verified in code) but no test pins noc_panel_hit, the scroll-vs-zoom branch, the modal block, or release-build always-zooms. The PP_CAM_E2E captures are manual one-shot artifacts.
findings.fix: Fixture-App unit pins (the pullback_test precedent): wheel over panel scrolls-not-zooms (PP_DEBUG), modal blocks zoom+pan, elsewhere zooms; pin noc_panel_hit inside/boundary/outside.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL — P1 coverage ~0% (effect compositions, yield clears, touch pan, latch edges all untested)
findings.detail: P0 100% (camera math, intent wiring, conflict gates, pullback feed/ease/toggle, settings v2/v1 — all pinned, suites green). P1 ~0%: every composition-level behavior (the five pullback-yield clears, NOC ownership branches, touch-pan positive, poll guard/begin_draw/start_run latch transitions) is untested; deleting any single clear or the touch Pan emission keeps all 11 gates green.
findings.fix: Pin the effect branches + yield clears + a Two_Finger_Pan->on_pan delta test + the latch transitions; that lifts P1 to >=90% and the gate to PASS.

findings.title: Pan latch strands when the settings modal opens mid-drag — stale pan_last lurches the camera on close
findings.location: app/input/mouse.odin panel branch; app/input/exec.odin Toggle_Settings; app/input/poll.odin guard
findings.detail: S key / pad Y mid-pan opens the modal without clearing inp.panning; the panel-suppress branch drops the release (real and every-frame synthetic) without closing the latch; on close the accumulated synthetic release fires Pan{cur - stale press anchor} — a full-displacement camera jump.
findings.fix: Clear inp.panning (+ pan_last) when Toggle_Settings opens the panel, or in the panel_open-suppressed branch when panning is set.

findings.title: No cross-frame wheel accumulator — sub-notch trackpad deltas truncate to a silent no-op; slow trackpad scrolling never zooms
findings.detail: raylib delivers fractional per-frame deltas on smooth trackpads; i32(delta) truncates |delta|<1 to zero notches every frame. PR body's 'accumulate per frame and fire whole notches' matches the old NOC-scroll truncation, but zoom is now a primary input on laptops.
findings.fix: Accumulate fractional wheel delta in Input state across frames; emit whole notches when the accumulator crosses +/-1, carry the residue.

findings.title: Pipe selection and camera_focus_pair never clear app.pullback — contradicts 'any selection change ends it'
findings.detail: The node leg and camera_set_fit clear pullback; the pipe leg (QoS click-select) and camera_focus_pair (crisis banner) set 2.6x targets without clearing — the focus eases at the 0.05 pullback rate (~1.5-2s) instead of 0.14 (~0.5s), and a later SEED can retarget the camera away from the user's selection.
findings.fix: Add app.pullback = false beside the cam_zoom_to = 2.6 writes in the pipe leg and camera_focus_pair.

findings.title: pullback_feed's id walk-back misattributes when a player router placement shares the frame with a growth spawn — the SEED pullback is silently skipped
findings.detail: apply_place consumes a node id WITHOUT emitting NODE_SPAWNED; the count-based walk-back (next_node_id - remaining) then points at the router (kind != Terminal -> skipped) and the real seed is never classified.
findings.fix: Track the previous frame's next_node_id on the App; classify every id spawned in the window (prev..next) instead of deriving ids from the event count alone.

findings.title: effect_pan scales drag deltas by the eased zoom TARGET, not the live scale its comment promises
findings.detail: camera_pan_center is called with cam_zoom_to while content renders at cam_zoom; mid-wheel-ease drags mis-track the cursor by the target/live ratio. effect_zoom anchors against the live transform — inconsistent.
findings.fix: Pass the live zoom to camera_pan_center (matching effect_zoom's live anchoring) and fix the comment — or document the target-scale choice deliberately.

findings.title: v2 settings loader applies the pullback byte before the shared range checks — a mixed-corrupt file returns defaults-except-pullback, not DEFAULT_A11Y
findings.detail: s.auto_pullback = data[5] is set inside the v2 branch; a later palette/motion/scale range failure returns the mutated s. All existing out-of-range tests use pullback byte 1, masking it.
findings.fix: Apply payload bytes only after every range check passes (or reset to DEFAULT_A11Y on each rejection); add a mixed-corruption test with pullback=0.

findings.title: camera_spawn_is_seed 'exact mirror' diverges on same-window siblings — a younger attach within 10 tiles flips a genuine seed to attach
findings.detail: The core classified the candidate at spawn time (siblings not yet live); the view classifies after — same-slice siblings (multi-tick catch-up window + an attach to the brand-new estate) join the distance set and suppress the pullback. Narrow but real; the 'exact mirror' comment overclaims.
findings.fix: Exclude ids spawned within the same events window from the sibling set (classify against terminals older than the window start).

findings.title: Pullback-yield paths untested: the five wheel/pan/selection/fit/toggle clears of an in-flight pullback have no test
findings.detail: PR claims 'any user camera input yields the pullback instantly'; five distinct clears implement it and none is exercised — deleting any one keeps every gate green.
findings.fix: Extend pullback_test: arm a pullback, then call effect_zoom/effect_pan/camera_set_selection/camera_set_fit + the row-5 toggle; assert pullback == false after each.

findings.title: Two-finger touch pan has no positive pin — deleting touch_map's Pan emission keeps all gates green
findings.detail: PR claims 'two-finger touch pan now works'; the exec Pan->on_pan seam is pinned via mouse only; the parity scenario asserts only the no-command contract.
findings.fix: One camera_input_test case: dispatch Two_Finger_Pan{dx,dy} device events and assert on_pan receives the exact deltas through touch_map.

findings.title: Pan-latch lifecycle edges untested: missed-release guard, begin_draw clear, start_run reset
findings.detail: Three new latch transitions have zero coverage; camera_input_test drives dispatch_frame directly, never the poll guard. A regression strands the latch -> buttonless panning (W1 shows the strand is real).
findings.fix: Factor the poll guard's condition into a testable predicate; assert begin_draw/start_run clear an armed latch; pin the synthetic-release close.

findings.title: Fit derivation triplicated despite camera_fit's 'ONE source' comment
findings.detail: The same min() expression lives in camera_fit, camera_update (inline), and view_compute. A future fit-rule change must be synchronized in three places or views diverge silently.
findings.fix: camera_update should call camera_fit(v); soften the comment or export a render-side helper for view_compute.

findings.title: Test-count claims misaligned: PR says 4 camera-math tests (actual 6), 14 new (actual 16); briefing says 18 pins
findings.detail: Undercount (coverage exceeds the claim) but three inconsistent counts (14/16/18) for the same change-set mislead future audits.
findings.fix: Correct the PR body to 6 camera-math tests / 16 new tests, or reconcile the 'pins' vs 'tests' terminology.

findings.title: 'panned release never click-selects' assertion cannot fail — nothing was selected beforehand
findings.detail: The release asserts sel_node == -1 with nothing selected and empty ground under the release — the moved-check suppression this claims to pin is untested (deleting it keeps the suite green).
findings.fix: Select a node before the pan, release over it, assert it stays unselected.

findings.title: camera_clamp_center test comment ('x is free', '960px viewport') contradicts its own both-axes-pin assertion
findings.detail: At FIT42 the 1280px window spans ~1386 world px > 1040 world width — both axes pin, as asserted; the comment's reasoning is wrong and self-contradictory ('At z < 1.08 both pin' includes the tested z=1.0).
findings.fix: Rewrite the comment: at the fit the viewport exceeds the world on both axes, so both coordinates clamp to the world center.

findings.title: pullback_feed re-implements spawn_fx_feed's NODE_SPAWNED id walk-back
findings.detail: Two independent copies of the zero-payload spawn-event->node-id derivation; behaviorally identical today, must be fixed in both if event ordering changes.
findings.fix: Extract one shared helper and call it from both feeds.

findings.title: New camera/pullback tests skip the catalogs_destroy cleanup the package's own fixture precedent uses
findings.detail: exec_test defers pp.catalogs_destroy; the new tests leak the catalogs and the new'd View under tracking-allocator runs (ODN-18 discipline).
findings.fix: Add defer pp.catalogs_destroy(...) to each new test; free or stack-allocate the View.

findings.title: harness/parity.odin still documents Pan as 'a no-op today' after this diff makes it pan
findings.detail: The scenario comment predates the change — misleading for the next reader.
findings.fix: Reword: Pan routes to on_pan; the parity harness leaves the hook nil so the scenario still expects no commands.

findings.title: SEED during an active pan drag: per-frame zero-delta Pan clears the flag but the zoom-out target survives
findings.location: app/main.odin effect_pan + pullback_feed (frame order: feed 539 -> handle_input 578)
findings.detail: A stationary held drag emits Pan{0,0} every frame, clearing an armed pullback while its zoom-out targets persist — the breathe-out runs at the normal 0.14 rate mid-drag: neither a clean yield nor a clean pullback.
findings.fix: In effect_pan, if the pullback was armed this frame and delta is zero, either fully yield (revert the zoom target) or keep the flag — define the intended behavior.

findings.title: PP_CAM_E2E drive is manual-only evidence — wired into no CI gate or helper (like NOC_E2E)
findings.detail: The committed zoom captures can silently go stale; consistent with the pre-existing NOC_E2E pattern.
findings.fix: Add a run-dev.sh subcommand documenting PP_CAM_E2E=1; optionally a manual step that regenerates and pixel-diffs the captures.

findings.title: Settings save writes a predictable .tmp sibling without O_EXCL — a pre-placed symlink is followed
findings.detail: write_entire_file uses O_WRONLY|O_CREATE|O_TRUNC; negligible on a single-user desktop with 0700 HOME.
findings.fix: Open the tmp with O_CREATE|O_EXCL (skip on collision) or use a unique temp name.

findings.title: App.auto_pullback mirrors App.a11y.auto_pullback — two sources of truth synced by hand
findings.detail: A future writer updating one copy silently diverges feed behavior from the persisted setting and panel display.
findings.fix: Delete App.auto_pullback; read app.a11y.auto_pullback directly in the feed, the HUD snapshot, and the toggle effect.
